lines: Q3 2026 revenue was $411.5 million, up 23% year over year; Diagnostics revenue was $303.5 million (+20%) and Data and Applications revenue was $108.1 million (+33%).
Oncology test volume increased 32% year over year; MRD volume was approximately 12,000 tests, up 300% year over year.
Gross profit was $266.7 million, up 27%; GAAP net loss was $14.9 million (GAAP diluted loss per share $0.08).
Adjusted EBITDA was $25.6 million versus $1.5 million in Q3 2025; non-GAAP net income per share was $0.07.
Full-year 2026 revenue guidance increased to $1.600-$1.605 billion; adjusted EBITDA guidance remains approximately $65 million.

Cash and marketable securities were $854.4 million at quarter end; company said regulatory review of the proposed Personalis acquisition cleared and a Personalis shareholder vote is planned for November 30, 2026.
